reason: I've never heard of Claro, there's no mention of reviews or independent testing, and a creator plug alone isn't proof. I only travel a few times a year, so I'm not locking into a filter subscription with a brand I can't vet.
objection: It's a brand-new Shopify store with zero track record. 'The supplier rates each filter' isn't third-party certification, and for all I know it's a rebadged generic bottle I could find cheaper elsewhere.
would_change_my_mind: Hundreds of verified reviews plus independent lab or NSF certification of what the filter actually removes.
